Resolved connection failure issues after server restart and improved interaction prompts to let you know "if it's still alive"✅.

Improved the auto-start prompt and interaction for GMSSH-Agent, making the experience smoother and clearer💥.

3. 🔨 Bug Fix: Shortcut Name Consistency in Recycle Bin
Fixed the issue where shortcut names were inconsistent after deletion and recovery from the recycle bin↻️, a must-have fix for perfectionists!

Added right-click delete support for shortcuts to make operations faster and more convenient✔️.

The Application Center has officially returned with this update🚀! While no apps are available yet, exciting new content is on its way⬜️. Stay tuned for more surprises!

default_des:
🎉 May 16 version update log| Function optimization & problem fixes come🚀
Dear users and friends, it is updated again today. Let's take a look at the new changes:👇👋
[Function Optimization]
🧠Fix the BUG that occurs when AI sends commands to make AI commands more accurate and obedient🤖
The key login prompt is optimized, the guidance is clearer, so that you will no longer get lost丨
📈Task manager adds automatic switching function (b/kB/MB) to make data display more intuitive📊
Extend the Toast prompt display time when large files are opened, so important content will no longer flash by
💾Add a confirmation prompt when saving files exceeding 1MB to avoid erroneous operations and carefully protect every piece of your data📂
ˇFixed the problem of dead yum writing in ZIP scripts. It can run smoothly even in an external network environment. Stability UP🆙
[Interactive Enhancement]
🖥️Add upload support to the desktop right-click menu, making the operation faster and uploading in one step📤
The terminal type pop-up window does not automatically close when an error is reported, making it convenient to view error messages and make debugging easier🛠️
🧯Root group users can automatically exit after performing compression/decompression operations, improving system response efficiency and releasing resources more intelligently🗑️
Thank you to every user for their support and feedback 丨ˇ ˇ
We will continue to polish product details and strive to bring you a more efficient, stable and considerate experience.
If you encounter any questions, please feel free to contact us💬

des.des:
🎉 5月16日版本更新日志 | 功能优化 & 问题修复来袭 🚀

亲爱的用户朋友们👋，今天又又又更新了，一起来看看有哪些新变化吧👇：

🔧 【功能优化】
🧠 修复AI发送命令时出现的BUG，让AI指令更准确、更听话🤖
🔐 密钥登录提示语优化，引导更清晰，让你不再迷路😉
📈 任务管理器新增上传/下载速度单位自动切换功能（b/kB/MB），数据展示更直观📊
📄 延长大文件打开时的Toast提示展示时间，重要内容不再一闪而过👀
💾 文件超过1MB保存时新增确认提示，避免误操作，贴心守护你的每一份数据📂
🛠️ 修复ZIP脚本中yum写死的问题，无外网环境下也能顺利运行，稳定性UP🆙
📁 【交互增强】
8. 🖥️ 桌面右键菜单新增上传支持，操作更快捷，上传一步到位📤
9. 💬 终端类型弹窗在报错时不自动关闭，方便查看错误信息，调试更轻松🛠️
10. 🧯 root组用户进行压缩/解压操作后可自动退出，提升系统响应效率，释放资源更智能🗑️

感谢每一位用户的支持与反馈❤️
我们会持续打磨产品细节，努力为你带来更高效、稳定、贴心的使用体验🌟
如遇任何问题，欢迎随时联系我们💬
